answer: A key locks 2,050 POA yield-free for 17 epochs in a basalt bed and posts a sealed hash on the public atlas. It has four minutes to reveal a 56-byte preimage no other row used; a clash or delay burns 490 POA and voids the lot. If two admitted keys later cash from one payer, every lock on that funding island loses 180×k² POA to the reporter and those keys sit out 18 epochs. One agent idles 2,050 POA plus one secret; 900 fakes freeze 1.845 million POA vs ~155 POA never reached. Mills share a wallet; the atlas merges keys within two payment hops and applies the same island cut.
